notes: Three old kinds kept with old s; lager, kveik/farmhouse and wild/souring kinds added. Chico strain versions by lab (WLP001, 1056, US-05) from The Electric Brewery page. Liquid equivalents of W-34/70 and Wyeast saison/1968 not added (only forum sources). No Lactobacillus product page retrieved, so souring bacteria are types only. Algae trimmed to Spirulina and Chlorella archetypes; other old cultures kept in m. Baker's yeast stays in J5.
